description:
SNORKEL PARADISE AWAITS – Kealakekua Bay, the Marine Sanctuary of Magic! 🐠

2 snorkeling locations!

Get ready to dive into the most jaw-dropping, crystal-clear waters on the Big Island – this is the world-famous Kona Coast at its absolute finest!

Snorkeling over abundant coral gardens packed with neon fish and pods of spinner dolphins playing in the distance. 

This isn’t just snorkeling – this is snorkeling in one of Hawaii’s most protected marine sanctuaries!

Highlights That Will Leave You Speechless:

Pristine, clear water with 100+ ft visibility on calm days (yes, it’s THAT good!)

Cruise along the dramatic Kona coastline to hidden coves and secret snorkel spots most visitors never see.

Visit the legendary Captain Cook Monument in Kealakekua Bay – a postcard-perfect, turquoise paradise and one of the best snorkel sites on the planet!

Your captain picks the day’s ultimate spot based on conditions, guest vibe, and where the ocean is showing off the most – guaranteeing you the best possible adventure!

Whether we stop at the iconic Captain Cook Monument or sneak you into a private, secluded bay only the locals know about – every trip is a new, unforgettable underwater explosion of color and life!

Limited spots, epic conditions, and memories that will ruin all future snorkeling for you (in the best way possible).

Grab your mask – the reef is calling your name!

Mahalo & see you on the boat!

what_is_not_included_items.value: Prescription mask, Lifejacket, and Wetsuit (must rent ahead of time if wanted)

itinerary:
Check-In and Gear Up for Adventure! 🌊

1. Arrive at our harbor spot in Kailua-Kona, where our friendly crew greets you with aloha spirit. 

Pro tip: Slather on that reef-safe sunscreen now

2. Hop aboard our speedy, stable vessel for a thrilling 20-30 minute cruise down the stunning Kona Coast. Feel the salty breeze, spot leaping dolphins or breaching whales (in season), and soak in jaw-dropping views of rugged lava cliffs and turquoise waters.

3. Arrive at the marine sanctuary know as Kealakekua bay (Captain Cook Monument)

4. On board safety speech and snorkel + mask handout. 

5. Dive into Snorkel Heaven – Explore the Coral Wonderland! 🤿

6. Slip into the crystal-clear bay (100+ ft visibility on good days) for 45-60 minutes of pure water bliss. Float effortlessly over thriving coral gardens teeming with rainbow fish and maybe even a curious octopus or eel.

7. Sea Caves and Lava Tubes (If Mother Nature Agrees!) 🌋🕳️
Weather and conditions permitting, we'll detour to nearby hidden treasures along the coast. Cruise by dramatic sea caves carved by ancient waves and eerie lava tubes from volcanic eruptions – nature's own sculptures! Snap epic photos, learn cool geology facts from the captain and crew, and feel the raw power of Hawaii's wild side. (If conditions aren't ideal, we'll maximize your snorkel time instead – flexibility is key!)

8. Smooth Sail Back to Harbor – Relive the Magic! ⚓🌅
Time to head home with hearts full and cameras bursting. High-fives all around – you've just conquered one of the Big Island's top adventures!

Mahalo for joining us – until next time, keep that aloha vibe alive! ✨

faqs:
- **Is swimming with dolphins part of the tour?** No, dolphins may be seen, but swimming with them is not permitted.
- **Are sea caves guaranteed on the tour?** Sea cave visits are weather-dependent and may be canceled if conditions are unsafe.
- **Are prescription masks available?** No, please rent them separately from Snorkel Bob's or Boss Frog if needed.
